data.name: Manafi
data.long_meaning: One who gives or bestows. Derived from the verb ‘anafa’, meaning ‘to give’.

in_arabic.name: منافع
in_arabic.meaning: المنافع هي الأعمال الصالحة التي يحتسبها الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: المنافع هي الأعمال الصالحة التي يحتسبها الله تعالى، وهي الأعمال التي تكون لها أثراً في الدنيا والآخرة، مثل الصدقة والصبر والصالحة، وهي مما يزكي الأعمال، ويحسّنها، ويجعلها طاهرة في وجدان الله، ويعين على القيام بها القلب الصادق، والجسد الصالح، والروح الحية، والمشاعر النقية

in_urdu.name: منافع
in_urdu.meaning: منافع کا مطلب ہے پاک اور صالح کام
in_urdu.long_meaning: منافع کا مطلب ہے پاک اور صالح کام جو الله تعالیٰ کی محبت میں ہوتے ہیں، ان میں سادھ، صبر، اور نیک کام شامل ہیں، یہ کام دنیا اور آخرت میں اچھے نتائج کے لئے ہوتے ہیں، اور الله تعالیٰ ان کاموں کو اچھا سمجھتا ہے، ان کاموں کو پاک اور صاف سمجھتا ہے اور ان کاموں کو کرنے والوں کو اچھا سمجھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मनाफ़ी
in_hindi.meaning: मनाफ़ी का अर्थ है अच्छा और पवित्र काम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मनाफ़ी का अर्थ है अच्छा और पवित्र काम जो अल्लाह की भक्ति में होते हैं, इसमें सादगी, धैर्य, और सत्कर्म शामिल हैं, यह काम दुनिया और आखिरत में अच्छे परिणाम के लिए होते हैं, और अल्लाह इन कामों को अच्छा मानता है, इन कामों को पवित्र मानता है, और इन कामों को करने वालों को अच्छा मानता है

in_pashto.name: منافع
in_pashto.long_meaning: منافع دویځې څښتیزې کارونه دي چې الله تعالی دویځې پر کښلي، په دنيا وروسته هم ډوډۍ ګړنکي کارونه دي، دویځې کارونه چې په الله تعالی دویځې پر کښلي، دویځې دویځې کارونه دي چې دویځې پر کښلي، او دویځې کارونه چې دویځې پر کښلي، دویځې پر کښلي دویځې کارونه دي چې دویځې پر کښلي

in_english.name: Manafi
in_english.meaning: Manafi means beneficial and virtuous deeds
in_english.long_meaning: Manafi refers to beneficial and virtuous deeds that are pleasing to Allah. These deeds are those that have a positive impact in this life and the hereafter. Examples include charity, patience, and good deeds. Allah rewards and accepts these deeds, and they are considered to be pure and righteous. Performing such deeds is considered a means of attaining spiritual growth and closeness to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Manafi holds a significant cultural impact through the charitable and giving nature it represents. In Islamic tradition, giving to charity is an essential practice, and the name Manafi embodies that spirit. It is a reminder that every action, regardless of its size, has the power to make a positive impact. The name also signifies generosity and kindness, both vital elements in building and strengthening community bonds.
data.spiritual_significance: Manafi holds a deep spiritual significance as it is an encouragement to embody the essence of God, who is the giver of all blessings. Just as we strive to emulate God by giving to others in our daily lives, the name Manafi acts as a reminder that we are His servants and that we have a sacred duty to give and share what we have with those in need. This spiritual connection reaffirms the importance of compassion, empathy, and selflessness, ultimately allowing us to connect with the Divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah: The Prolegomena - Book 1, Chapter 1, Section 2 The name Manafi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun describes Manafi as a mountain region in northern Morocco, known for its fertile valleys and dense forests. He mentions that the Berbers of this region were renowned for their courage and military prowess.

historical_references.reference: Al-Idrisi's The Description of the World: Kitāb Rūh al-ʿāqī al-maqdīm fī aḥkām al-bilād wa'l-mamālik - Section 2, Chapter 1
historical_references.context: Al-Idrisi refers to Manafi as a mountainous region located in present-day Algeria, between the regions of Cabisa and Mzab. He notes that it was inhabited by Berber tribes who were known for their agriculture and their production of wine.
